work_info.title: What is Data Management?
descriptions: Data Management involves organizing, storing, and securing business information to ensure it remains accurate, accessible, and protected. Effective data management helps streamline operations, reduce errors, and enable informed, data-driven decision-making.

list.content: Data Collection & Organization: Structuring information for easy access and usability.
Data Cleaning & Validation: Ensuring accuracy, consistency, and reliability of data.
Secure Storage & Access Control: Protecting sensitive information while enabling authorized access.
Integration & Automation: Connecting systems and automating workflows for efficiency.
Reporting & Insights: Providing actionable data insights to support business decisions.
